mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing temperatures around 70 degrees with fog along the Military Ridge State Trail. It is a Waning Gibbous moon phase tonight, and if you are up early, look for the International Space Station passing over at 5:52 AM, rising in the west-northwest over Cross Plains and traveling toward the east-southeast near Festival Foods, where it will be visible almost directly overhead.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center is undergoing a major flooring renovation starting September 1. Residents should note that the center will have limited programming from September 1 through 9, with a full closure on Labor Day. Also, public works crews are currently addressing a water main break near 212 Todd Street, which has caused a temporary water shutoff for local properties.

We have plenty of activity to look forward to. Today, Hop Haus Trivia is at Hop Haus Brewing Co. and Quizmasters Trivia is held at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and more live music and pizza specials around town.

Looking at the weekly police report, on August 30, officers were called to the 800 block of North Edge Trail for a vehicle window that was smashed intentionally. The suspect fled the scene, but officers have identified the individual and have an arrest warrant pending.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently closed, but it will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
